text:
From Sri (the owner), word for word: "Drop the time limits for now. Let's just measure how long things take and why"

Background (not Sri's own words; added so the request can be read on its own): the time limits in athena.toml were raised by hand to 24 hours (reader, planner, critic, producer, verifier; checks to 4 hours), so this request is the measuring half. Six jobs between 13 and 14 Nov failed when the planner, at xhigh effort on revision rounds, hit the old 600 s limit. What is wanted: for each stage of each job (reading, each planning round, producer, checks, verifier, landing, waiting in the queue, waiting for disk), record and show how long it took, and the main reason it took that long (model and effort, tokens, tool calls, build and test time, retries, waits), so slow stages can be explained rather than cut off.
